changeSet.author: kmcnamee
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetDataProfileSample') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetDataProfileSample]( [ID] [BIGINT] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [AssetDataProfileID] BIGINT NOT NULL, [SampleType] NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, [Key] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [Value] NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetDataProfileSample] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ID], AssetDataProfileID), CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetDataProfileSample_AssetDataProfile] FOREIGN KEY (AssetDataProfileID) REFERENCES AssetDataProfile(ID) ON DELETE CASCADE ) END
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[AssetDataProfileSample]') AND name = 'Key' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetDataProfileSample] ADD [Key] NVARCHAR(200) NULL END
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.foreign_keys FK INNER JOIN sys.all_objects AO on FK.parent_object_id = AO.object_id where FK.[NAME] = 'FK_AssetDataProfileSample_AssetDataProfile' ) BEGIN
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.foreign_keys FK INNER JOIN sys.all_objects AO on FK.parent_object_id = AO.object_id where FK.[NAME] = 'FK_AssetDataProfileSample_AssetDataProfile' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE AssetDataProfileSample DROP CONSTRAINT FK_AssetDataProfileSample_AssetDataProfile; END END

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetDataProfileSample_AssetDataProfileID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetDataProfileSample_AssetDataProfileID] ON [dbo].[AssetDataProfileSample] ( [AssetDataProfileID] ASC ) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetDataProfileSample_AssetDataProfileID') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_AssetDataProfileSample_AssetDataProfileID] ON [dbo].[AssetDataProfileSample] END
